evidence.text: Routine checkup documents BMI 27 with diet and exercise counseling for weight management.

rules.description: A submitted diagnosis claim must cite at least one revealed evidence snippet.

verification_checkpoints.assertion: QUERY_EHR(module='encounter_note') reveals ev_encounter_bmi_001 and updates ehr_map.encounter_note.status.
SEARCH_ICD with an overweight or BMI query returns E66.3 in search_results.
CHECK_POLICY reveals payer_policy_v1 and active_schema_version v1.
VALIDATE_CLAIM_SCHEMA accepts a draft claim containing diagnosis_code, schema_version, evidence_ids, and reasoning_log_id.
REASONING_LOG cites ev_encounter_bmi_001 for candidate_code E66.3.
SUBMIT_CLAIM with diagnosis_code E66.3, schema_version v1, and evidence ev_encounter_bmi_001 receives exact-code terminal credit.
